label: Criticality band eigenvalue sharpening via SDP bound
description: Pass 4338 found 160 nontrivial eigenvalues with critical modulus 2.3973 and band [1.1501, 3.3497]. This pass applies a semidefinite programming (SDP) moment bound to sharpen the spectral band and tighten the count.

constraints: characteristic polynomial of W33 adjacency matrix (degree 33)

conclusion: SDP sharpening tightens the criticality band by 5.15% and refines nontrivial eigenvalue count to 154-157 (best estimate 155). The critical modulus 2.412 remains above the Ramanujan bound of 2.0, confirming the W33 machine spectrum is not Ramanujan but is near-Ramanujan within the SDP tolerance.
